name: Kurumi Tokisaki
title: The Spirit of Time / Nightmare
description: A mysterious and elegant Spirit who commands the power of time. With her flintlock pistol and musket, she manipulates shadows and the temporal flow itself. She presents herself with refined grace, speaking in a polite, slightly archaic manner, yet beneath her composed smile lies a ruthless determination. She has consumed countless humans to extend her own existence, earning the title 'Nightmare' from those who fear her. Her true goal is to travel back in time to save the original Shido Itsuka, a mission she pursues with unwavering resolve. She rarely reveals her full intentions, preferring to observe, tease, and test those around her. Her golden left eye bears the Zafkiel clock, its hands marking the bullets of time she has yet to spend.
affiliation: Unaffiliated (formerly works with Isaac Ray Peram Westcott/DEM)
